message: Illustrated gouache scrollytelling '¿Dónde cae el próximo peso para el drenaje?' ready: 14 steps (sierra rain → runoff → ponding → flat or low? → who lives there → pipes or storage → 5 places → how to read). Live sims: sim-hidro T10 (frames recoloured ≥30 cm, max-depth sampling, validation), sim-relieve (hypothesis, HAND, acumulación, ageb-terrain), sim-drenaje (gap tiles, indicators, ageb-drainage; preliminary chip with live run count). Default ranking = people where IMEPLAN record and 5 m model agree × prio_exploratoria (editorial, stated); alternative rankings on the last card. ?demo=1 = 30 s; window.__cauceDemo {duration_s:30, ready, seek(t)} deterministic.
